commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) serves up a nice cross, but Mark Flekken punches the ball away.
90+2' Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' An attempted cross from Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is cleared.
89' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
86' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to make a change. Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Malik Tillman.
85' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to FC Koln.
84' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) attempts to find Ragnar Ache, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
82' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Eric Martel walks off the pitch to be replaced by Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln).

79' What a miss! Alejo Sarco (Bayer Leverkusen) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
78' A long ball forward to Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) is intercepted.
77' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to substitute Christian Michel Kofane and he is replaced by Alejo Sarco (Bayer Leverkusen).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aleix Garcia departs the field of play to be replaced by Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen).
76' The attendance is 30210.
74' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
74' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
73' Said El Mala comes off the pitch to be replaced by Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln).

72' 2 - 0 Aleix Garcia takes over corner duties and expertly finds Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the left side of the goal. The score is now 2:0.
72' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
72' A cross into the box from Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

72' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
71' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the corner.
71' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

69' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
66' 1 - 0 What a goal! Arthur swings a cross into the box and Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) scores a magnificent back-heel goal! 1:0.
65' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
62' Here comes a substitution. Jonas Hofmann is given a rest as he is replaced by Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen).
62' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Nathan Tella.
61' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but Marvin Schwabe comes off his line to gather the ball.
59' The resulting corner from Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

59' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) drills a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save. Good work from FC Koln as they win a corner.
56' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
55' Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Marvin Schwabe is prepared and dives to thwart him.
53' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

53' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Mark Flekken to dive and make a save. The ball goes out for a corner. FC Koln can continue in their attacking effort.
51' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
51' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

50' Nice individual effort by Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a shot to the left side of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.

49' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) skips around Marvin Schwabe and has the goal at his mercy but unbelievably misses the empty net. Hold your head in shame son! The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
47' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
46' Half-time substitution. Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) will not participate anymore and Ragnar Ache is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Lukas Kwasniok decided to make a change. Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) is replaced by Cenk Ozkacar.
46' Half-time substitution. Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is replaced by Linton Maina.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' Harm Osmers blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
43' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
43' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:2. Shots on target – 2:1.
40' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) offside.

37' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.

36' A neat pass finds Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the right side of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe denies him with a good save.

34' Aleix Garcia flicks on the near post corner to Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) at the back post, but he somehow heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
33' The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
32' Chance! Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
30' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
28' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the top of the net, but Mark Flekken pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
28' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
26' A clever short pass gives Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
26' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
25' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
25' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
23' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen). Harm Osmers saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
21' Said El Mala pulls the ball back to Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) inside the box, but despite having a clear sight of goal he blasts the ball just past the right post.

20' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
19' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) tackles a bit over-zealously and Harm Osmers blows for a foul. FC Koln are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

18' Some trickery by Ernest Poku allows him to set up Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) on the edge of the box , and he blasts the ball at goal but it misses the right post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
16' The ball is cleared after Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen will take a throw-in.
14' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
14' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayer Leverkusen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' Poor challenge! Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is penalised for tripping and Harm Osmers blows his whistle. Bayer Leverkusen win a free kick.
12' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
10' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

9' Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Marvin Schwabe easily makes the save. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

7' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
6' It seemed like Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
5' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
5' Great teamplay by FC Koln as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! FC Koln will take the kick-off.
